metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: This animated comedy follows a quirky family on a road trip who must save the world from robots, offering a mix of humor, action, and heart similar to movies like 'Despicable Me' and 'Zootopia'.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A heartwarming comedy about a lovable bear from Peru who travels to London. Its charm, humor, and family-friendly adventure make it a great fit for fans of 'Matilda' and 'Annie'.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: The sequel continues the delightful adventures of Paddington Bear, filled with more humor, kindness, and gentle escapades that appeal to the whole family, much like 'Toy Story' films.

metas.name: Klaus
metas.description: This beautifully animated film offers a unique and heartwarming origin story for Santa Claus, featuring humor, adventure, and a strong family message reminiscent of 'The Grinch'.

metas.name: The LEGO Movie
metas.description: A wildly imaginative and hilarious animated adventure with a fantastic story and visual style, perfect for kids who enjoyed the humor and action in 'Shrek' and 'Kung Fu Panda'.

metas.name: The Addams Family
metas.description: This animated adaptation brings the iconic spooky family to life with humor and a fun story, suitable for families who enjoyed the quirky fantasy of 'Alice in Wonderland' and 'Shrek'.

metas.name: The Addams Family 2
metas.description: Continuing the animated adventures of the peculiar Addams family, this film offers more gags and family road trip fun that kids who enjoy dark humor in a lighthearted way will love.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A fun and energetic animated comedy about monsters who run a hotel for monsters, offering plenty of laughs and a family-friendly twist on spooky themes, similar to 'Monsters, Inc.'.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania 2
metas.description: The sequel continues the comedic adventures with Dracula and his monster friends, focusing on family and acceptance with plenty of visual gags that kids will find hilarious.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation
metas.description: This installment takes the monster family on a cruise vacation, filled with more animated hijinks and humor that appeals to a younger audience, echoing the fun of 'Despicable Me'.

metas.name: Vivo
metas.description: An animated musical adventure about a musical kinkajou who travels from Havana to Miami, filled with catchy songs and a heartwarming story, perfect for fans of 'Moana' and 'Encanto'.

metas.name: Lu Over the Wall
metas.description: A whimsical animated film from Japan about a mermaid and a young boy, offering fantasy and musical elements that fans of Studio Ghibli films like 'Ponyo' might enjoy.

metas.name: The Willoughbys
metas.description: This dark yet comedic animated film follows four siblings who plan to get rid of their selfish parents, offering a quirky adventure with a unique visual style similar to 'The Bad Guys'.

metas.name: Mary and the Witch's Flower
metas.description: From Studio Ponoc, this animated fantasy adventure tells the story of a young girl who discovers a magical flower, appealing to fans of magical adventures like 'Kiki's Delivery Service' and 'Spirited Away'.

metas.name: Next Gen
metas.description: A sci-fi animated adventure about a lonely girl who befriends a robot, featuring action and a strong friendship theme that might appeal to fans of 'Raya and the Last Dragon' and 'The Sea Beast'.

metas.name: Scoob!
metas.description: An animated comedy adventure featuring Scooby-Doo and the gang, offering familiar characters, mystery, and humor that kids who enjoy classic animated franchises will love, similar to 'Chicken Run'.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A prehistoric family comedy adventure with stunning animation and a story about adapting to change, appealing to fans of 'Ice Age' and 'Migration'.

metas.name: The Croods: A New Age
metas.description: The sequel continues the hilarious adventures of the Croods as they encounter a more advanced family, packed with comedy, action, and visual spectacle, fitting with 'The Super Mario Bros. Movie'.

metas.name: Nimona
metas.description: A unique animated fantasy-comedy about a shapeshifter who partners with a knight, offering a fresh story with humor and heart, fitting well with the adventure and animation of 'Puss in Boots: The Last Wish'.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: An animated musical comedy about a jaded 74-year-old lizard, the class pet, who learns he has only one year left to live. It's funny and uplifting, similar to 'Sing' and 'Encanto'.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: An animated adventure where a young boy faces his fears with the help of the embodiment of darkness. It's whimsical and charming, with a touch of fantasy, like 'Ponyo' and 'My Neighbor Totoro'.

metas.name: Space Chimps
metas.description: A fun animated adventure comedy about chimpanzees sent on a space mission, offering lighthearted humor and action that kids who enjoy 'Rio' and 'Ice Age' might like.

metas.name: The Angry Birds Movie
metas.description: Based on the popular game, this animated comedy follows flightless birds defending their island from green pigs, featuring fast-paced humor and action akin to 'Despicable Me'.

metas.name: The Angry Birds Movie 2
metas.description: The sequel teams up birds and pigs to face a new, greater threat, offering more comedic antics and adventure that fans of the first film and other animated comedies will enjoy.

metas.name: The Lorax
metas.description: An animated musical fantasy film with a strong environmental message, featuring vibrant animation and humor that aligns with the spirit of films like 'The Grinch' and 'Turning Red'.

metas.name: Open Season
metas.description: An animated comedy about a grizzly bear and a deer who must protect the forest from hunters, offering plenty of slapstick humor and adventure suitable for the family, reminiscent of 'Rio'.

metas.name: Open Season 2
metas.description: The sequel follows the forest animals in a new adventure to rescue their friends, continuing the comedic tone and family-friendly escapades.

metas.name: Open Season 3
metas.description: More animated hijinks ensue as the animal friends go on another quest, keeping the humor and lighthearted adventure that fans of the series enjoy.

metas.name: Arthur Christmas
metas.description: A clever and charming animated film about Santa's son who undertakes a mission to deliver a gift using a high-tech operation, filled with humor and holiday spirit, like 'The Grinch'.

metas.name: Surf's Up
metas.description: This animated mockumentary follows a penguin surfer's journey, offering humor, adventure, and a unique visual style that might appeal to fans of 'Finding Nemo' and 'Rio'.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An imaginative animated comedy about an inventor whose machine creates food from the sky, leading to chaotic and hilarious consequences. It shares the zany humor of 'Despicable Me'.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
metas.description: The sequel introduces a world of living food-creatures, continuing the inventive humor and colorful animation that made the first film a hit, fitting with the fun of 'Toy Story'.

metas.name: Home
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy about an alien on the run who befriends a human girl, featuring a heartwarming story, humor, and adventure, similar to 'Zootopia' and 'Monsters, Inc.'.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A spectacular animated adventure about a Viking boy who befriends a dragon, offering breathtaking visuals, emotional depth, and thrilling action, aligning with 'The Sea Beast' and 'Raya and the Last Dragon'.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: The sequel expands the world and the emotional stakes as Hiccup and Toothless discover a new threat, continuing the adventure and character development loved by fans of 'Tangled' and 'Moana'.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
metas.description: The final installment in the trilogy delivers a satisfying conclusion with stunning animation, epic action, and a touching story about growing up, appealing to fans of grand animated adventures.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: This charming animated film from Pixar explores themes of friendship and acceptance through the eyes of two sea monsters experiencing the human world, perfect for fans of 'Finding Nemo' and 'Moana'.

metas.name: Encanto
metas.description: A vibrant and magical animated musical about a Colombian family with unique gifts, filled with catchy songs, stunning visuals, and a heartwarming story about family. (Note: Already in watch history, but a perfect recommendation if it were not. Including for completeness of style match.)
